title: Mom High On Xanax Brutally Crashes Her Car With A Minor Inside
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On December 20th, 2023. Officers were called to the scene of a brutal crash, where a woman drove right into a fence with her daughter in the car. The car was a total loss. Upon further investigation, the woman said she had been prescribed multiple pills and had taken them earlier during the day, however, she seemed to be still drowsy and slow during the time of investigation.( She later admitted that she took one of her prescription drugs at 1pm which was 3 hours before the crash). Her husband arrived on the scene and said she had a history of drug problems in the past and she was currently recovering. Officers then discovered a pill bottle with Xanax inside, along with other drug paraphernalia and two unopened bottles of alcohol, which she recently just bought. A DUI investigation then began and she couldn't finish any of the field sobriety tests leading to her arrest. This is the body-cam footage of the events.
